text_block_list.text: The day of the Kyoto Shimbun Hai—

text_block_list.name: Spectator A
text_block_list.text:
—Now then, I wonder how the Kyoto Shimbun Hai will turn out.
Who will step up to enter the Derby...?

text_block_list.name: Spectator B
text_block_list.text:
Last year's Derby Umamusume ran in the Prix de l'Arc de Triomphe too, which was so hype...!
And in that recent Osaka Hai, she also—

text_block_list.name: Sounds of Earth
text_block_list.text: (First, let's go with "valiant"—)

text_block_list.name: Spectator C
text_block_list.text: Huh, what...? A violin...!?

text_block_list.name: Spectator D
text_block_list.text:
"...That girl, she was trending online a while ago, wasn't she?
You know, the one who talks about racing through music—"

text_block_list.name: Sounds of Earth
text_block_list.text:
(Now, let's convey it to the audience.
The player's exhilaration and tension...!)

text_block_list.name: Spectator A
text_block_list.text:
Ooh...!?
S-Something's—

text_block_list.name: Spectator A
text_block_list.text: It kind of... makes me want to straighten my back. Like I'm getting tense... or something—

text_block_list.name: Spectator C
text_block_list.text:
Such a serious look...
It's strange, it feels kind of like how she looks before a race...
(Clap clap clap clap—)

text_block_list.name: Sounds of Earth
text_block_list.text: You have just listened to a piece expressing the resolve of those facing the races, titled "Journeying to the Light"—

text_block_list.name: Sounds of Earth
text_block_list.text:
"And I am Sounds of Earth!
The one who will play a melody louder and prouder
than anyone else in today's Kyoto Shimbun Hai!!"

text_block_list.name: Sounds of Earth
text_block_list.text:
Who will seize the glory
that paves the way to the Derby?

text_block_list.name: Sounds of Earth
text_block_list.text: Please, see it for yourselves with your own eyes.

text_block_list.name: Spectator D
text_block_list.text:
—Whoaaa, that's so cool...!
Now I'm looking forward to the
Kyoto Shimbun Hai even more!

text_block_list.name: Spectator A
text_block_list.text: That performance earlier really touched my heart...

text_block_list.name: Spectator A
text_block_list.text: The resolve of those who step onto the track, huh? Today's race is turning out to be something to look forward to...!

text_block_list.name: Sounds of Earth
text_block_list.text: —I'm back, Trainer.
choice_data_list: Welcome back. How did they react?

text_block_list.name: Sounds of Earth
text_block_list.text:
Looking great! It seems everyone has
high expectations for today's race...!
choice_data_list: Then all that's left is to live up to it.

text_block_list.name: Sounds of Earth
text_block_list.text:
Sì! Let us let them hear it to their hearts' content!
The melody we have honed so carefully...!
